name: Alessandra Bellini
bio:
Alessandra's journey into motorsport started unexpectedly. While pursuing a degree in materials engineering, she attended a local rally and was captivated by the intricate carbon fiber work on the cars. She switched her focus to composite materials and secured an internship with a small Italian GT team. There, she honed her skills in repairing and optimizing composite components, quickly gaining a reputation for her meticulous approach and problem-solving abilities.

Driven by a desire to work at the highest level, Alessandra joined Mercedes-AMG a decade ago. She's known for her unwavering commitment to precision and her relentless pursuit of perfection in every composite piece she works on. Her colleagues appreciate her dedication, even if her exacting standards sometimes lead to delays. Alessandra believes that every gram saved and every fraction of a degree improved can make the difference between victory and defeat.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, often pulled back in a practical bun.
physical.description: Alessandra is of average height with a strong, focused gaze, reflecting years of detailed work.

quirks: Always sharpens her pencils to a needle point.
Insists on using a specific brand of Italian coffee, even at the track.
Secretly codes complex jigsaws as relaxation in the evening.
